notes.title: Camped Out! Patch 1.1.1 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
We've just released a patch for Camped Out! which introduces a new layout for the existing keyboard configuration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792934/5300105cf362eb5eabee3363fe7a4615c733b5c5.jpg[/img]

Players now have the option of selecting either control layout when playing on keyboard, and two players can play off a single keyboard (either physically, or across a Remote Play session) using both layouts.

We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Camped Out! Patch 1.1.0 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
We have just released the first major patch for Camped Out! - version 1.1.0. The most notable change to the game is the addition of a new [b]Peaceful[/b] difficulty mode.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/840880/Camped_Out/?curator_clanid=27440015][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Fd-b0mRVsAAIKE4?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

On Peaceful difficulty, players of all ages and skill levels can take their time a little more and enjoy the campsites across the world of Camped Out! without the stress of bears, squirrels, beavers and the like. We've tweaked a number of settings to ensure a more peaceful camping experience, while still requiring strong co-operative play between all players to get the camp set up before nightfall.

We hope you enjoy this update!

1.1.0 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Added new Peaceful difficulty level with resource requirement reduction and various tweaks/balances
[*] Improvements to item placement when being removed from the backpack
[*] Reduced Pinefall's falling hazard zone
[*] Disabled game input when application not in focus
[*] Fixed a bug where players couldn't pick up an item near a switch
[*] Fixed a bug where placing a tent in the snow would cause pushback
[*] Fixed a bug where failing a level with an incomplete campfire would display the wrong scoreboard data
[*] Fixed a bug where respawning multiple items and players would have unexpected physics events
[*] Fixed a bug where players could trap a ghost within a tent blueprint
[/list]

notes.title: Camped Out! Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792934/3404201e30db64ce2c1bbe92d3cf433d9dc6de23.png[/img]

Today is a very exciting and emotional day for us. We finally get to release our little passion project out into the universe, and families and friends all over the world can begin their co-operative camping adventure! But first, story time..

Back in 2013, friends Andrew and Ian met their game developer idol, Ron Gilbert, at a Double Fine meet up during the first PAX Australia.

[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FdJdePNakAA6uRM?format=jpg&name=4096x4096][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FdJdePNakAA6uRM?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img][/url]

Shortly after this inspirational event, INCA Studios was founded, and the two began prototyping game ideas in their spare time. Eventually they landed on a concept that had some legs; a twist on the couch co-op genre centred around camping, a favourite pastime and yearly tradition of theirs.

The game took shape, and after a number of rigorous playtests with very patient and brutally honest friends, INCA took their game to PAX Australia 2018, and then back there the following year.

[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Dqgk4cvV4AEgIOR?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Dqgk4cvV4AEgIOR?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EGohE0BUEAEP24m?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EGohE0BUEAEP24m?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

Over the next few years, the two continued to further shape and hone the game, embarking on a long porting journey to make the game available on Nintendo Switch while still maintaining the experience for Steam players.

We now find ourselves with our game out in the wild, and we're so proud of it.

We hope you enjoy Camped Out - thanks for playing!

notes.title: Camped Out Release Date Announcement - 22nd September
notes.content:
Finally! After five long years, two PAX events, a global pandemic, a baby, and countless hours of playtesting... We are very happy to announce the release date of Camped Out is [b]22nd September[/b]!

Featuring:
🏕️ 20 breathtaking campsites
🗺️ A vast world map to uncover
🚩 Unique and exciting hazards
🐻 Squirrels, beavers, snakes, and a bear!

Camped Out is the perfect choice for games night - and you can easily invite friends and family across the globe to join your camping adventure with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Remote Play Together[/url]!

notes.title: Camped Out Pre-Release Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]Introducing: Camped Out![/h3]
Camped Out is a frenetic couch co-op game for friends and families, where up to four players work together to set up camp before darkness falls. Each level is a race against the clock where players are required to build tents, construct a campfire, cook enough food and get into bed before the night arrives.

If you're a fan of Overcooked and co-operative gaming, you'll feel right at home with Camped Out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792934/3088a2a95088230b19f4236575597dc7870d6053.png[/img]
[h3]The Demo[/h3]
The pre-release demo throws you right into the action, with a quick tutorial to teach you ropes before opening up the first two areas of the game world, which includes 4 more campsites to complete. The game can be played with up to four players, either local co-op or using Steam's Remote Play Together, and comes with full controller support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792934/3f296864a16dcb58a039d0fa06270c76dae7def5.png[/img]
Please note that this pre-release demo is unoptimized and you may encounter bugs. We hope you enjoy your journey.
